TRIALIQ-101 — Phase II Investigational Study
Participant PT-1042
Multiple screening laboratory values fail protocol thresholds, and significant protocol deviations and missing documentation prevent confirmation of eligibility and safety review readiness.

Participant PT-1042 presents multiple screening laboratory failures including hemoglobin (10.2 g/dL vs >=12.0 g/dL required), ANC (1.1 ×10⁹/L vs >=1.5 ×10⁹/L required), platelets (145 ×10⁹/L vs >=150 ×10⁹/L required), creatinine (1.4 mg/dL vs <=1.2 mg/dL required), ALT (82 U/L vs <=45 U/L required), and AST (76 U/L vs <=40 U/L required). A protocol deviation occurred with the Day 15 visit occurring on Day 21 due to transportation issues, resulting in out-of-window CBC collection. Grade 2 nausea and vomiting began on 05-Aug-2026, approximately 18 hours post-treatment, prompting a temporary study dose hold. Several non-laboratory criteria, prednisone dose/washout applicability, and MedDRA coding terms lack affirmative source evidence.
